description: Create a purchase demand on the exchange and wait for trading proposals in response.
usage_note: Use is_beer_game_mode and action_constraints from procurement.json.policy_context, trade_decision_card.policy_context, or blackboard.policy_context_by_department.procurement. In beer_game mode, prefer create_replenishment_order when allowed. Use this action only when a real required quantity is known and the replenishment-policy action is inapplicable.
conditions: analysis identifies a material shortage, supply risk, or need to secure materials in advance.
Inventory is below its safety threshold or cannot support an existing production plan.
A pending production plan cannot start because materials are insufficient.
Expected demand growth warrants securing material supply in advance.
trade_decision_card.delta.pressure_changes shows falling inventory_position and rising backlog for a material, while create_replenishment_order is currently unsuitable.
parameter_constraints: material_id must identify an existing material visible in inventory information.
An initially small quantity may be adjusted later as trading conditions become clear.
When creating action.json from this template, action_param must contain exactly the fields listed in required_parameters, with none added or omitted.
constraints: Verify that procurement staffing meets the minimum requirement.
Ensure cash covers both material and logistics costs.
Warehouse capacity is not currently validated by the system; avoid obviously excessive purchases.
Use this action only when canonical primary inputs establish a real shortfall and create_replenishment_order is inapplicable.
If trade_decision_card recommends create_replenishment_order for the same material_id, use that action instead of supplying a manually estimated quantity.
